Houthis Attack Saudi Oil Sites After Yemen Airstrikes

Iran-backed Houthi rebels launched missile and drone attacks targeting Saudi state oil company Aramco facilities in Jizan and Yanbu. The Houthis stated these strikes were in response to airstrikes in Yemen. A Saudi vessel sustained minor hull damage in a Red Sea attack. The attacks occurred after a period where the US had held back from striking Iran for two weeks.
